name: Codex Hierosolymitanus 54
note: The only complete Greek text, rediscovered in 1873.

name: P.Oxy. XV 1782
note: Two parchment leaves of a miniature codex with Greek fragments of Didache chapters 1–3, the earliest surviving Greek witness. Designated P.Oxy. as part of the Oxyrhynchus series, but not papyrus.

editorial.note: Exact contents differ between descriptions (1.3b–4a with either 2.1–3.2a or 2.7b–3.2a); to be settled from the 1922 edition.

material: parchment (two leaves of a miniature codex)

name: Coptic fragment, British Library Or. 9271
note: A Coptic version of part of the later chapters.

name: Apostolic Constitutions, Book 7
note: A later church order that reworks much of the Didache.
